events.verdict: James (LAL) places his hand onto Monk's (SAC) left arm and impedes his movement as he pursues the loose ball. The contact is not deemed a transition take foul because Monk does not have possession of the loose ball and the illegal contact occurs within the last two minutes of the 4th quarter/Overtime.
Reaves (LAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Davis (LAL) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Sabonis (SAC) and is not in a legal guarding position as contact occurs with Sabonis' body during his upward shooting motion.
James (LAL) does not overtly or abruptly extend his leg and incidental foot to foot contact occurs with Sabonis (SAC) following the jump shot attempt.
Reaves (LAL) moves alongside Fox's (SAC) path and maintains a legal guarding position as incidental contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.

Monk (SAC) reaches in and initially makes incidental hand-on-ball contact with James (LAL) that dislodges the ball. As the ball becomes loose, Monk's hand follows through, and incidental contact occurs with James' wrist.
The ball last touches Davis' (LAL) left arm before going out of bounds. Possession should have been awarded to SAC.
Monk (SAC) is stepping toward Davis' (LAL) body as he contests the shot, initiating contact that affects the jump shot attempt.
Fox (SAC) commits a take foul on Reaves (LAL).
Christie (LAL) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Fox's (SAC) arms prior to release.
